sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content: By accessing our app, you automatically agree to these Terms of Service. The app is designed to help manage and split expenses easily among multiple people.

sections.heading: Registration and Account
sections.content: Each user is responsible for the information provided during registration and for keeping their login credentials confidential.

sections.heading: Conditions of Use
sections.content: Users must use the app properly and avoid any harmful or fraudulent behavior.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: We are not responsible for any financial losses or disputes between users resulting from misuse of the app.

sections.heading: Changes to the Terms
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms. Users will be notified through updates within the app.

sections.heading: Governing Law and Disputes
sections.content: These terms are governed by Italian law.

sections.heading: Types of Data Collected
sections.content: We collect essential personal data needed for the app to function, such as name, email, and information related to expense sharing.

sections.heading: How Data is Used
sections.content: The data collected is used solely to provide and improve the service offered by the app.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.content: Personal data is not shared with third parties, except when required by law.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.content: We use only technical cookies necessary for the app's operation and user authentication.

sections.heading: User Rights
sections.content: Each user may request access to, correction, or deletion of their personal data by sending us a request via email.

sections.heading: Security
sections.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of the personal data collected.

sections.heading: Changes to the Privacy Policy
sections.content: Any changes will be promptly communicated to users through in-app notifications.
